title: DIYFPV build import in the core
goal: A DIYFPV builder link becomes a stored build in FPVBuddy
acceptance: The core checks a DIYFPV builder link and parses its page tables into a build as NERV's src/diyfpv-build.ts does; how the server reads the page (NERV uses a browser read) is named in the record; specs carried over from test/diyfpv-build.test.ts
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
Owner data, export files and ID maps never enter Git

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: a 113-line parser and its test; reading the page server-side carries the uncertainty. Not a measurement.
